_comment: Direct HTTP MCP config: connect Claude Code straight to a running luxd, with no per-session process in the path. This is the alternative to the plugin's own 'lux mcp-serve' entry, and the difference is menus: a session connected this way gets the whole tool surface but cannot own menu entries, because it holds no connection a click could be pushed down (register_callback is refused, saying so). luxd must be running (lux hub-install, or luxd in a terminal). The url below hard-codes the default port 8430; luxd may bind a different (ephemeral) port, so read the actual port from the hub.port file (HubPaths().read_port(), i.e. ~/.punt-labs/lux/hub.port) and update the url to match. scripts/direct_connection_probe.py resolves the port that way and verifies the endpoint end to end.
